title: fix: accept gpt-4o-transcribe as a GPT Transcribe alias
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `gpt-4o-transcribe` as an alias of `openai/gpt-transcribe`
- Fixes OpenAI clients whose default transcription model name was rejected
- Adds an alias test so the OpenAI name stays supported

| Request `model` on `/v1/audio/transcriptions` | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `gpt-4o-transcribe` | 400 "Invalid model or alias" | Transcribed by GPT Transcribe |
| `whisper-1`, `gpt-transcribe` | Works | Unchanged |

`gpt-4o-mini-tts` is deliberately not aliased. `tts-1` would ignore its `instructions` and reject its newer voices (`coral`, `ash`, `sage`…).

gist.headline: The hive recognizes that name
gist.blurb: OpenAI clients call it `gpt-4o-transcribe`; the hive knows it as GPT Transcribe. The two names finally get introduced.
gist.summary: Adds `gpt-4o-transcribe` as an alias of `openai/gpt-transcribe` on `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, with a test to keep the OpenAI model name supported.
gist.impact: OpenAI clients using `gpt-4o-transcribe` get a transcription instead of a 400 “Invalid model or alias” response; `whisper-1` and `gpt-transcribe` remain unchanged.
